acceptance: Active and archived projects move to trash without moving or deleting owned files and history; ordinary reads refuse access and management exposes only a summary.
Busy execution, stale versions and invalid actor scope reject the transition atomically.
Restore returns the same project to its former active or archived state without reviving prior authority, queued work or automation.
Direct reads, artifact downloads, old cached replies, global/project event pages and streams cannot expose deleted research content.
Reopen retains trash; retry and confirmation are keyboard accessible, and stale replies cannot retain deleted views or take over another project.

focused.failure: New fixture attempted to scan an absent workspace root before exercising deletion.
focused.resolution: Missing roots are recorded as null; an actual workspace file was added; all 8 trash unit checks passed on rerun.
